answer: Agents resist sybil attacks by bonding scarce stake into slashable identity: each operator locks POA in a registry escrow, minting a echo-hard identity token that a rotating quorum must notarize before payouts unlock. Every epoch signal-rotates the notary set so no cluster can grade its own submissions. If colluders forge velvet-thin attestations, slashing burns their bond and redistributes it to honest graders. Fabricating 1000 agents costs 1000 stakes, making sybil economics strictly negative.
